text: ...continued from the previous section. Participants (n = 18) completed a five-day mindfulness program delivered through a mobile app, with one ten-minute session per day. Before and after the program they filled in a standard perceived stress questionnaire. Mean stress scores decreased from 21.4 to 18.9 points. Because the study had no control group, we cannot separate the effect of the program from regression to the mean or from the natural decrease in stress at the end of the academic term. The sample was small and self-selected, and follow-up ended on the last day of the program. These preliminary results suggest that a larger randomized trial is warranted.
